body_blocks.text: Three things going on the weekend of May 23–25, plus a few open slots we're flagging while there's still time to book.
Grill-prep cooking class — Saturday May 23, 11 AM

Two hours, hands-on. Marinades, rubs, plating, the timing of getting four things off the grill at once. You leave with three recipes and the marinades pre-made. $65 a seat. 14 seats total — 6 left as of this email.

May 23 and May 30 are the last two Saturdays for graduation parties before our summer pause on event bookings. Up to 100 guests, three vendors on the menu, full bar, the patio in play if the weather holds.
If you came in for Mother's Day brunch on the 10th — thank you. Both seatings were full and we're glad you were there.
ChefScape · 1602 Village Market Blvd SE, Leesburg VA 20175 · (703) 480-5100
